summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K attaching a September 16, 2026 news release disclosing its acquisition of Safari Flower Company, adding EU-GMP-certified indoor cultivation capacity, alongside recently announced UK deals for Internode Pharma and HAP Pharma. No purchase price, share count or premium was disclosed. Management reaffirmed FY27 Q2 sequential net revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth guidance, cited $149 million cash and no debt as of June 30, 2026, and said the ATM program will be used only when the Board deems it in shareholders' interest. Watch integration, EU-GMP supply ramp, ATM dilution risk.
